context:
Goal: tapping an order id opens that order on TCGplayer.
Problem: the link opens orderhistory?SearchString=<id>, the URL you gave on 2026-10-21. Nobody has checked whether the page applies the search and lands on the order, or just opens the plain order list.
Why yours: it needs your own TCGplayer sign-in and one of your real orders, and the safety rules keep a sign-in with your password for you.
ref: debt tcgplayer-link-opens-history-list (the order link may not search by order id); src/view-rules.mjs tcgplayerOrderUrl
steps: Sign in to TCGplayer in your browser.
In MANIFEST, tap the order id on any package.
Mark this done, and in the note say whether it opened that one order or the full order list.
title: Tap an order id link while signed in to TCGplayer, and say what opens
